title: Implement pkg/hlc Hybrid Logical Clock with drift clamp and total order
description: Pure-Go Hybrid Logical Clock: Clock holding {wallMillis/Physical, logical} with Now() advancing against an injectable wall-clock, Update(remote Timestamp) taking max of local/remote physical and bumping logical on ties, clamping NTP drift to a configurable bound (default 500ms; <10ms tolerance target) returning error on exceed, plus total-order Timestamp.Compare and HappensBefore/Concurrent. 52-bit physical microseconds + 12/16-bit logical. Timestamp substrate every CRDT consumes; unblocks pkg/crdt and pkg/swim/hierarchical.
closure_criteria: Run a Go program that feeds an out-of-order remote timestamp newer than local wall; capture before/after clock state showing the returned timestamp is strictly greater than both inputs and two events at identical wall time receive distinct logical counters preserving causal order; emit a per-run UUID into the log and attach the captured stdout proving deterministic causal ordering.

title: Implement pkg/crdt G-Counter with per-replica max-merge convergence
description: Grow-only counter CRDT over a per-node counts map; Increment(nodeID), Value()=sum, Merge(other)=element-wise max per node (commutative, associative, idempotent), and Encode() for network transfer. State-based, no networking.
closure_criteria: Run a property test merging the same increment ops in randomized orders across 3 in-process replicas, capture each replica's encoded state proving byte-identical convergence and that merging twice equals once; log a per-run UUID with the converged Value() and attach the captured output.

title: Implement pkg/crdt LWW-Register with HLC last-writer-wins tiebreak
description: Last-write-wins register CRDT storing value + HLC timestamp + nodeID; Set(value,ts,nodeID) updates only if ts greater (or equal ts and higher nodeID for deterministic tiebreak), Get() returns value+metadata, Merge resolves via Compare. State-based CRDT over pkg/hlc.
closure_criteria: Run a test issuing concurrent Set calls with equal HLC timestamps but differing nodeIDs across replicas, capture before/after register state proving the deterministic higher-nodeID winner converges on all replicas; emit per-run UUID and attach captured output.

title: Implement pkg/crdt OR-Set with unique-tag add/remove semantics
description: Observed-Removed Set CRDT: Add(element,tag) with unique per-add tags, Remove(element) removes only observed tags (add-wins on concurrent add/remove), Contains/Elements, and commutative/associative/idempotent Merge of adds and removes maps.
closure_criteria: Run a randomized concurrent add/remove convergence test across 3 replicas, capture state proving an element concurrently added on one replica and removed on another converges to present (add-wins) byte-identically everywhere; log per-run UUID and attach output.

title: Implement pkg/crdt/merkle anti-entropy tree with divergent-key Diff
description: Merkle tree over a keyspace of CRDT registers with Insert(key,value) recomputing hashes up the tree, RootHash(), and Compare/Diff(remoteRoot) returning only divergent key ranges so reconciliation ships deltas not full state, honoring the <5 KB/s gossip budget. Pure-Go over an in-memory map, transport-agnostic. Depends on pkg/crdt.
closure_criteria: Run a test with two trees of N keys differing in exactly one deep key, capture Diff output proving it returns exactly that key range and that syncing it makes root hashes equal; log per-run UUID plus byte counts demonstrating delta (not full) transfer and attach output.

title: Implement Vector Clock causality type for Tier-2 operational state
description: VectorClock map[nodeID]uint64 with Increment, element-wise-max Merge, and Compare returning -1/0/1 (before/concurrent-or-equal/after) for precise causal ordering of Tier-2 operational state crossing cell boundaries.
closure_criteria: Run a test constructing concurrent and causally-ordered VC pairs, capture Compare outputs proving correct before/after/concurrent classification across node sets of differing membership; log per-run UUID and attach output.

title: Implement pkg/federation Cell model and lifecycle state machine
description: Pure-Go cell model Cell{ID, Gateways, State} and explicit FSM over states CREATING->DISCOVERING->AUTHENTICATING->JOINING->SYNCHRONIZING->OPERATING->LEAVING->CLEANUP (plus Failed) using a ValidTransitions map and CanTransition guard; Transition(cell,event) rejects illegal jumps with a typed error and leaves state unchanged.
closure_criteria: Run a driver that walks a cell through the legal happy path printing each state, then attempts an illegal jump (CLEANUP->OPERATING) and captures the typed rejection error with unchanged state; emit per-run UUID and attach the captured transition log.

title: Implement thread-safe Cell Registry with add/remove/list/snapshot
description: Thread-safe Registry in pkg/federation: AddCell, RemoveCell, ListCells, and a consistent Snapshot of cells with their states; concurrency-safe under RWMutex; backs federated API aggregation and CLI listing.
closure_criteria: Run a concurrency test adding/removing cells from multiple goroutines with -race, capture a Snapshot proving consistent membership with no data race report; log per-run UUID and attach race-detector-clean output.

title: Implement pkg/federation federated API aggregation with partial failure
description: Pure-Go fan-out/merge engine: given Active cells from the Registry and a per-cell query func (interface), aggregate results with partial-failure semantics returning successes plus a per-cell error map, never fail-closed on one cell. Engine behind helixctl get ... --all-cells.
closure_criteria: Run an aggregation over 3 fake cells where one returns an error; capture output proving 2 results returned plus 1 recorded error and no panic; emit per-run UUID and attach the aggregated result map.

title: Implement Phi-accrual failure detector in pkg/swim
description: Add phi.go to pkg/swim: sliding window of inter-arrival heartbeat intervals producing phi(now) from sample mean/variance (normal-CDF based), Heartbeat(), Phi(), SuspicionLevel(memberID), threshold-based IsSuspect/IsFailed (threshold ~8-12). Replace/augment the fixed-timeout FailureDetector so suspicion adapts to observed latency; injectable clock.
closure_criteria: Run a test feeding a steady 1s heartbeat stream then stopping; capture phi-over-time proving phi stays low while heartbeats arrive, crosses threshold within a bounded time after they stop, and a jittery-but-alive stream does NOT cross threshold; log per-run UUID and attach phi trace.

title: Implement pkg/swim/hierarchical two-tier LAN+WAN delegate gossip
description: Hierarchical SWIM extending pkg/swim: intra-cell LAN pool (gossip 200ms, probe 1s/timeout 500ms, suspicion x4, fanout 3, AES-256-GCM, up to 5000 nodes) and inter-cell WAN delegate pool of gateway nodes only (gossip 500ms, probe 5s/timeout 3s, suspicion x6, fanout 2, up to 100 delegates). GossipScope (IntraCell/InterCell/Federation), NodeMeta with HLC timestamp, scoped Broadcast, Members()/CellMembers(cellID), graceful Shutdown/Leave. Keeps WAN bandwidth O(cells).
closure_criteria: Stand up a multi-process two-cell gossip testbed; capture each gateway's observed member set and Prometheus gossip_tx_bytes proving cross-cell membership converges in O(log C) rounds with per-gateway bandwidth under 5 KB/s; log per-run UUID and attach membership table plus bandwidth metric.

title: Implement gateway-relayed cross-cell suspicion propagation
description: Add gateway-relay suspicion path so suspicion about a cell or delegate detected by one gateway is relayed across the inter-cell pool, distinguishing single-node failure from full-cell partition per the partition-vs-failure decision matrix. Targets sub-10s cross-cell failure detection.
closure_criteria: On a 10-cell testbed kill one gateway and capture the time from death to cross-cell suspicion propagation proving < 10 seconds; capture the partition-vs-failure classification log; emit per-run UUID and attach timing evidence.

title: Implement bootstrap/rendezvous strategies (static, DNS-SRV, DHT, cloud, mDNS)
description: Bootstrapper with pluggable BootstrapStrategy (Static seeds, DNS SRV _helix-gossip._tcp, Kademlia DHT key hash(helix:federation:v6), cloud metadata tag query, mDNS) plus RetryJoin with exponential backoff (1s base, 30s cap) to join a new cell into an existing federation.
closure_criteria: Run an end-to-end join using a static seed list against a live seed gateway and capture the new cell appearing in the federation member list; repeat with a failing seed showing RetryJoin backoff then success; emit per-run UUID and attach join logs.

title: Implement mDNS/DNS-SD local cell discovery advertiser and browser
description: Zero-config LAN discovery on _helix-cluster._tcp: mDNSServer advertising TXT records (cellid, nodeid, version, wgpubkey, clusteraddr) and mDNSBrowser parsing ServiceEntry into DiscoveredPeer{CellID,NodeID,IP,Port,WireGuardPubKey,ClusterAddr,TTL}, rejecting invalid entries. mDNS used ONLY for discovery; trust requires SPIFFE attestation afterward.
closure_criteria: Run two nodes on one LAN; capture the browser on node B discovering node A's advertised TXT records (correct cellid/nodeid/wgpubkey) within the discovery window (<30s); emit per-run UUID and attach the discovered-peer dump.

title: Implement pkg/nattraversal STUN client and NAT-type classification
description: STUN client querying reflexive address (querySTUN/querySTUNWithServer), local host-candidate enumeration, and NAT classification (None/FullCone/Restricted/PortRestricted/Symmetric/Blocked) via multi-server comparison per RFC 5780 behavior tests. Replaces the current stub that returns 'not available in this build'.
closure_criteria: Run against real STUN servers behind known NAT types in the test matrix; capture discovered reflexive addresses and the classified NAT type matching ground truth for each of 4 NAT types; emit per-run UUID and attach classification table.

title: Implement ICE candidate gathering, prioritization and connectivity checks
description: ICE engine: DiscoverCandidates gathering Host, ServerReflexive (STUN) and Relay (TURN) candidates; candidatePriority per RFC 8445; formCandidatePairs sorted by combined priority; Connect performing bounded-parallel connectivity checks (max 5) returning the best working candidate pair as a *net.UDPConn with UDP hole punching.
closure_criteria: Run two nodes behind separate non-symmetric NATs; capture a successful direct UDP path established via hole punch (candidate pair chosen, RTT measured) without relay; emit per-run UUID and attach the chosen-pair log and traffic proof.

title: Implement TURN relay allocation and fallback chain
description: TURN client (allocateTURN) with TURNCredentials{Username,Password,Realm}; embedded/Coturn relay reachable on TCP-443 for firewall bypass; integrated as priority-4 guaranteed fallback in the prioritized chain (Direct, STUN+hole-punch, UPnP/PCP opportunistic, TURN relay, libp2p circuit relay, SSH tunnel last-resort).
closure_criteria: Force a symmetric-NAT scenario where hole punching fails and capture data flowing through the allocated TURN relay (relay candidate selected, bytes relayed) proving 100% connectivity fallback; emit per-run UUID and attach relay traffic evidence.

title: Implement QUIC fallback transport with 0-RTT and connection migration
description: QUIC transport (quic-go) as UDP-based reliable fallback: QUICServer with Allow0RTT, EnableDatagrams, ALPN helix-federation/6.0, configurable idle timeout/keepalive (15s < NAT timeout), flow-control windows, path-MTU discovery, and ConnectionMigrationStats tracking migrations and 0-RTT resumes for IP changes without reconnect.
closure_criteria: Establish a QUIC connection, change the client source IP mid-stream and capture ConnectionMigrationStats proving migration succeeded with stream continuity and a 0-RTT resume on reconnect; emit per-run UUID and attach the stats dump.

title: Implement internal/cell WireGuard inter-cell mesh manager
description: Cell abstraction with WireGuard MeshManager: per-node wg-helix interface, AddPeer/RemovePeer/GetPeers, Peer{PublicKey,Endpoint,AllowedIPs,CellID,NodeID,Keepalive=25s}, preshared-key generation, gateway-node management, inter-cell route advertising, and SWIM delegate configuration. Encrypted data plane prerequisite for all federation traffic (ChaCha20-Poly1305).
closure_criteria: Bring up two real cells on separate hosts; capture a wg-helix tunnel established between gateways with iperf3 traffic flowing encrypted across cells (handshake + transfer logs); emit per-run UUID and attach wg show output and throughput.

title: Implement WireGuard zero-downtime key rotation with overlap window
description: Extend pkg/wireguard with zero-downtime key rotation: add the new key before removing the old (200ms overlap window) so the mesh does not flap during rotation; 24-hour ephemeral key rotation; multi-cell peer management and inter-cell route advertising. Builds on existing RotateKeysTracked audit recording.
closure_criteria: On a live multi-host mesh, rotate a gateway's key while iperf3 traffic flows and capture zero dropped-connection/handshake-failure events during the 200ms overlap window (continuous throughput graph); emit per-run UUID and attach the no-flap traffic evidence.

title: Implement SSH tunnel bridge fallback for control-plane bootstrap
description: Reverse/forward SSH tunnel bridge (autossh-style) per ssh-bridge.yaml: bastion host/port, identity key, tunnel local/remote ports (gossip 7946), keepalive interval and max failures; TCP-only last-resort path for admin access and bootstrap when UDP is blocked, explicitly not for data plane.
closure_criteria: Block UDP between two hosts, establish the SSH reverse tunnel and capture the gossip control channel succeeding over the tunnel (member join via tunneled port); emit per-run UUID and attach tunnel + join logs.

title: Implement cloud VPN bridge with provider-specific endpoint discovery
description: Cloud bridge per cloud-bridge.yaml for aws/gcp/azure/hetzner/generic: WireGuard endpoint discovery via stun/static/metadata-service, AWS Global Accelerator anycast, GCP Cloud Load Balancing anycast, TURN over UDP/TCP+TLS. Enables cloud spot instances to join as a sub-cell (Mode D Cloud Extension).
closure_criteria: Launch a real cloud instance and capture it joining an on-prem cell as a sub-cell via the cloud bridge (mesh peer established, node visible in federation) using metadata-service endpoint discovery; emit per-run UUID and attach join evidence.

title: Integrate libp2p DHT discovery, GossipSub and circuit relay
description: libp2p application-layer P2P complementing (not replacing) WireGuard: Kademlia DHT global peer finding, DHT+Bitswap content routing for large cross-cell objects, GossipSub v1.1 cross-cell event streaming, DCUtR + Circuit Relay v2 decentralized hole punching, QUIC transport.
closure_criteria: Run a 3-node libp2p network; capture a peer discovered via DHT without a central registry and a GossipSub message delivered cross-cell, plus a circuit-relay hole-punch upgrade to direct; emit per-run UUID and attach discovery/pubsub logs.

title: Implement pkg/spiffe/federation trust-bundle exchange across cells
description: SPIFFE/SPIRE nested topology (root trust anchor issuing per-cell intermediate CAs) with BundleCache mapping TrustDomain->CertPool with TTL+expiry, AddBundle, bundle-endpoint refresh (FederationConfig), SPIFFEID parse, VerifyPeerCertificate against local or federated bundles, FederationManager.CanCommunicate enforcing cross-domain trust. Separate trust domain per cell, federation via bundle endpoints (NOT shared CA); 1hr SVID TTL, rotate at 50%.
closure_criteria: Stand up two SPIRE servers as nested trust domains; capture cell A presenting a real SVID accepted by cell B only after the bundle exchange, and rejected before exchange or after expiry; emit per-run UUID and attach the mTLS verify success/failure log.

title: Implement OPA/Gatekeeper cross-cluster federated-trust admission
description: HelixFederatedTrust ConstraintTemplate + Rego rejecting pods whose helix.io/trust-domain annotation is not in allowedTrustDomains, applied at cell admission boundaries; default-deny posture so a compromised/unknown cell cannot place workloads. Extends internal/policy.
closure_criteria: On a live Gatekeeper-enabled cell, submit a pod with a non-federated trust-domain annotation and capture the admission denial message naming the rejected domain, plus an allowed-domain pod admitted; emit per-run UUID and attach kubectl apply output for both.

title: Implement OPA data-residency / data-sovereignty admission policy
description: HelixDataResidency ConstraintTemplate + Rego requiring pods labeled data-classification=eu-personal-data to carry required EU region nodeAffinity (topology.kubernetes.io/region starts with europe-), enforcing data sovereignty at scheduling boundary.
closure_criteria: Submit an EU-personal-data pod lacking EU affinity to a live cell and capture the admission rejection, then a compliant pod admitted; emit per-run UUID and attach both admission decisions.

title: Integrate External Secrets Operator + Vault for federation secrets
description: Secret management via ClusterSecretStore (Vault KV v2, kubernetes auth, role helix-cell-secrets) and ExternalSecret syncing the federation-ca-bundle with 1h refresh; HSM-protected CA keys per threat model.
closure_criteria: On a live cell with Vault, store a CA bundle in Vault and capture the ExternalSecret materializing the Kubernetes secret and a workload consuming it after a Vault-side rotation reflected within the refresh interval; emit per-run UUID and attach the synced secret metadata.

title: Implement double-encryption (WireGuard L3 + mTLS L7) data path
description: Defense-in-depth: L3 WireGuard ChaCha20-Poly1305 node-to-node (ephemeral keys, 24h rotation) under L7 mTLS TLS1.3/AES-256-GCM service-to-service keyed by SPIFFE SVIDs (1h TTL, 50% rotation), within performance envelope (~38% P99 overhead combined, WireGuard <5% CPU at 1 Gbps).
closure_criteria: Capture a cross-cell service call traversing both layers: tcpdump showing WireGuard-encrypted UDP on the wire plus the inner mTLS handshake with SPIFFE-ID verification, and a perf/iperf3 measurement confirming WireGuard CPU <5% at 1 Gbps; emit per-run UUID and attach captures.

title: Implement pkg/cilium Cluster Mesh client and global-service propagation
description: Cilium Cluster Mesh client: per-cell unique cluster ID (1-255), etcd-backed endpoint/identity/policy synchronization between cells, CiliumIdentity propagation, and io.cilium/global-service annotation handling so a service is load-balanced cross-cell via eBPF kernel datapath (0.5-1ms p99 overhead) without gateway hops or sidecars.
closure_criteria: On two Cilium cells, annotate a service global-service=true and capture a pod in cell Alpha reaching payment-api transparently load-balanced to a healthy instance in cell Beta (request served cross-cell, endpoints propagated); emit per-run UUID and attach the cross-cell request trace.

title: Implement federated service discovery (cell-local + global registry)
description: Two-level service discovery: cell-local registry answering local requests plus a global federated registry answering cross-cell 'where is the service', backing global DNS resolution; works with Cilium Cluster Mesh for the data path.
closure_criteria: Register a service in cell Alpha and capture a client in cell Beta resolving it through the global registry and connecting; remove the Alpha instance and capture failover to a Gamma instance; emit per-run UUID and attach resolution logs.

title: Implement internal/federation Karmada PropagationPolicy engine
description: Karmada/OCM integration: PropagationPolicy engine for two-level scheduling (global picks cell, local Omega picks node), OverridePolicy per cluster, and federated kubectl aggregation. Constraints: data locality, latency, cost, compliance. Targets cross-cell workload failover < 60s.
closure_criteria: On a real multi-cluster Karmada hub, deploy a workload via PropagationPolicy across 3 cells, kill the gateway/cell hosting it and capture the workload rescheduled to another cell in < 60 seconds (pod Running elsewhere); emit per-run UUID and attach Karmada status + timing.

title: Extend pkg/scheduler with latency-aware spot/preemptible scoring
description: Inter-cell scheduler extension: latency-aware spot/preemptible placement scoring feeding Karmada propagation, honoring topology keys (region/zone), spot tolerations (120s grace, preStop drain) and the measured-latency reference (etcd never crosses region >10ms). Targets 40-60% cloud cost reduction via bursting.
closure_criteria: Run a 30-day-equivalent (or accelerated) spot-vs-on-demand billing comparison on a real cloud burst pool and capture 40-60% cost reduction while honoring latency constraints (no etcd cross-region); emit per-run UUID and attach the billing delta report.

title: Implement cloud bursting auto-scaling burst pool with spot termination handling
description: Cloud burst pool auto-scaling 0-500 spot/preemptible instances across AWS/GCP/Azure/Hetzner, triggered at CPU>80% for 5 min, with graceful 2-min termination warning handling (terminationGracePeriodSeconds 120, preStop drain) so on-prem cells extend into cloud when saturated (Mode D).
closure_criteria: Drive a real on-prem cell past 80% CPU for 5 min and capture spot instances joining the burst pool, workloads scheduled onto them, and graceful drain on a spot-termination notice with no request loss; emit per-run UUID and attach scale-up/drain logs.

title: Implement pkg/gitops ArgoCD ApplicationSet federation client
description: ArgoCD ApplicationSet client generating one Application per target cell from a single template (matrix generator: cluster auto-discovery + per-cell Git overlay), syncPolicy automated prune+self-heal, and RollingSync progressive rollout (canary -> tier-2 50% -> tier-1 25%); drift detection; GitOps federation pipeline. Single-commit deploy to all cells.
closure_criteria: On a live ArgoCD with 3 registered cells, commit a 3-tier app to Git and capture ApplicationSet generating per-cell Applications and rolling out canary-first then tiered, with a removed Git resource pruned from a cell (self-heal); emit per-run UUID and attach ArgoCD sync status screenshots/logs.

title: Implement CRDT-based config sync for cell-local overrides
description: Partition-tolerant CRDT-backed config sync for dynamic cell-local overrides complementing GitOps base config: a feature flag flippable locally via the cell config API and converging to other cells via gossip in 5-30s, vs ArgoCD Git path in 1-3 min.
closure_criteria: On a multi-cell testbed, flip a feature flag via one cell's config API during a brief partition and capture it converging to all healthy cells within 5-30s after heal (CRDT merge, no conflict); emit per-run UUID and attach per-cell flag-state timeline.

title: Implement cmd/helix-federation binary and helixctl federation CLI
description: Federation CLI surface: cmd/helix-federation plus helixctl federation subcommands including 'cell join', 'cell leave/evacuate', and '--all-cells' aggregated reads (e.g. helixctl get pods --all-cells) wired to the Registry, lifecycle FSM and federated aggregation engine. Operator-facing entry point for all federation flows.
closure_criteria: As an operator on a real two-cell testbed run 'helix cell join' and capture the new cell reaching OPERATING in < 60s, then run 'helixctl get pods --all-cells' capturing merged output across both cells; emit per-run UUID and attach the terminal recording.
source_refs: phase_06/PHASE_6_ROADMAP.md#8 Exit gates e2e operator flows

title: Extend internal/node cell agent: gossip-tier selection + federation identity attestation
description: Cell agent in internal/node: selects gossip tier (gateway joins inter-cell pool, worker intra-cell only), performs federation identity attestation (SPIRE node attestation) at cell admission, and advertises NodeMeta capacity/role/region/wg key. Currently node agent has no cell/federation logic.
closure_criteria: Start a real node configured as gateway and another as worker; capture the gateway joining both gossip pools and the worker only the intra pool, each completing SPIRE attestation before trust; emit per-run UUID and attach the agent role/attestation logs.

title: Enforce etcd-stays-within-cell static-analysis lint gate
description: Static-analysis lint rule + CI gate forbidding etcd endpoints outside the cell CIDR so Raft/etcd is never accidentally stretched across WAN (a Critical-impact risk). Per-cell strong consistency invariant enforced mechanically.
closure_criteria: Add a config referencing an out-of-cell etcd endpoint and capture the CI gate failing with the offending endpoint named; fix it and capture the gate passing; emit per-run UUID and attach both CI run links.
source_refs: phase_06/PHASE_6_ROADMAP.md#7 Risk etcd stretched across WAN

title: Implement per-cell etcd Raft WAN-safe tuning profiles
description: Per-cell etcd Raft tuning profiles for LAN vs same-region WAN: heartbeat 100ms/200-500ms, election timeout 1000ms/2000-5000ms (>=10x max RTT), snapshot chunk 64KB-1MB, max inflight 256/512-1024, Pre-Vote enabled/required, Check Quorum enabled on WAN so an isolated leader steps down. Up to 3 AZs within a region only.
closure_criteria: Deploy a 3-node etcd across 3 same-region AZs with the WAN profile, inject an AZ partition and capture the isolated minority going read-only (leader steps down via CheckQuorum, no split-brain) with commit latency within target; emit per-run UUID and attach etcd metrics.

title: Implement split-brain prevention and partition-classification logic
description: Split-brain prevention pipeline: SWIM+Phi detection, partition-vs-failure classification (all-cell-unreachable=partition vs some=partial), per-cell etcd majority-quorum enforcement (minority read-only), CRDT auto-merge + Merkle compare on heal, and leader fencing via CheckQuorum, per the partition decision matrix.
closure_criteria: On a multi-cell testbed inject a full inter-cell partition and capture both sides operating autonomously with no dual-leader writes, then heal and capture CRDT convergence; emit per-run UUID and attach the classification + post-heal convergence log.

title: Implement internal/chaos CE-01..CE-12 chaos experiment suite
description: 12 automated chaos experiments (CE-01..CE-12) with Chaos Mesh controller hooks and CI integration: pod/node kills, rolling cell drain, full and asymmetric inter-cell partitions (tc netem directional filters), gateway loss, clock skew +/-500ms (HLC absorbs), cascading sequential cell failures, etc., each with defined abort criteria and Game Day cadence.
closure_criteria: Run the full 12-experiment suite against a real multi-node testbed and capture a 12/12 pass report where each experiment's expected behavior held and abort criteria did not trigger; emit per-run UUID and attach the chaos CI report with per-experiment evidence.

title: Implement Turmoil-style deterministic multi-cluster simulation harness
description: Deterministic simulation harness (Turmoil-style, seed-reproducible) simulating up to 100 cells with WAN latency, partitions and node churn; covers gossip convergence (O(log C) rounds), split-brain prevention, CRDT monotonicity and message durability under single-node failure; runs every PR producing replayable trace files.
closure_criteria: Run the simulation on a fixed seed and capture bit-identical replay plus passing assertions for gossip convergence and CRDT monotonicity across a simulated 100-cell run; corrupt one invariant and capture the harness producing a replayable failing trace; emit per-run UUID and attach the trace.

title: Establish quarterly Game Day federation chaos drill protocol
description: Four-per-year Game Day protocol: pre-drill alignment doc one week prior, 24h on-call notice, blast radius limited to 30% of production traffic, written abort criteria (abort if API error rate >1% for 60s), and a 48h retrospective; four defined scenarios.
closure_criteria: Execute one Game Day against staging following the protocol and capture the completed alignment doc, the live abort-criteria monitoring (never tripped or correctly aborted), and the filed 48h retrospective; emit per-run UUID and attach the drill record.

title: Author Phase 6 FMEA catalog with detection and recovery runbooks
description: FMEA catalog (F-01..F-11+) covering split-brain dual leaders, complete cell failure, etcd quorum loss, asymmetric partition, etc., each with cause, detection signal/latency, effect, recovery procedure (e.g. Velero restore ~15min RPO), mitigation, plus failure-interaction/cascading analysis and circuit-breaker/bulkhead isolation design.
closure_criteria: For each FMEA entry, trigger the failure on the testbed and capture the documented detection signal firing within its stated latency and the runbook recovery succeeding; emit per-run UUID and attach the FMEA-validation log mapping each row to evidence.

title: Implement hierarchical Prometheus federation across cells
description: Hierarchical Prometheus: each cell scrapes locally (15s) and adds external_labels (cell, region); a central Prometheus federates pre-aggregated recording-rule metrics from each cell's /federate endpoint (60s) with honor_labels=true; optional regional aggregation tier beyond 100 cells. Exposes helix_gossip_tx_bytes_per_sec and federation KPIs.
closure_criteria: On a multi-cell deployment capture the central Prometheus returning aggregated cross-cell series with preserved cell/region labels and the gossip-bandwidth metric queryable; emit per-run UUID and attach a PromQL query screenshot proving cross-cell aggregation.

title: Implement OpenTelemetry cross-cell distributed tracing
description: Cell-level OpenTelemetry Collector configuration enabling trace context propagation across cell boundaries so a request spanning multiple cells produces a single correlated trace, exported to a central backend.
closure_criteria: Issue a request that crosses two cells and capture a single trace in the backend containing spans from both cells with correct parent/child linkage; emit per-run UUID and attach the trace view.

title: Implement split-brain detection PromQL alerts with runbook links
description: Central-Prometheus alert rules evaluated every 15s detecting consensus divergence (e.g. etcd_server_is_leader summed >1 across a cell, etcd_server_has_leader==0) firing a split-brain alert with runbook_url; targets split-brain alert latency < 30s.
closure_criteria: Inject a partition producing dual leaders via Chaos Mesh and capture the split-brain alert firing in < 30 seconds with its runbook link in the notification; emit per-run UUID and attach the alert timeline.

title: Build Grafana global-health cell-status-grid dashboard
description: Grafana Global Health dashboard with a cell status grid (each cell a colored square: green healthy / yellow degraded / red critical / gray partitioned) scaling to 255 cells, with drill-down from a cell to its cell-local Prometheus/Grafana for detailed debugging.
closure_criteria: On a live multi-cell deployment capture the dashboard correctly reflecting an induced cell-degraded state (square turns yellow/red) and a working drill-down to that cell's local metrics; emit per-run UUID and attach the dashboard screenshots before/after.

title: Implement Velero tiered disaster recovery backup and restore
description: Tiered DR: Velero hourly backups (Schedule, 30-day TTL, exclude ephemeral pods/events, volume snapshots) plus cross-region snapshot replication, with documented RTO/RPO tiers (active-active <15min/near-zero; warm standby; backup+restore; GitOps rebuild) and a cross-cluster restore procedure (deploy new cell with same cell ID, restore namespaces). Targets DR RPO < 15 min, restore < 15 min.
closure_criteria: Perform a real Velero restore drill: back up a namespace, destroy the source cell, and capture full-namespace restore to a secondary cell completing in < 15 minutes with workloads healthy and data loss within RPO; emit per-run UUID and attach the restore-drill timeline.

title: Implement five federation topology patterns and block-binding modes
description: Support configurable federation topologies (flat full-mesh, hierarchical tree, full mesh, partial mesh k-nearest for 20-255 cells, hub-and-spoke, equal-peer) and block-binding modes A (cluster-of-clusters default), B (equal-peer shared scheduler, only <10ms RTT), C (gateway bridging latency-aware routing), D (cloud extension sub-cell). Cell sizing ~5000 nodes, max 255 cells (511 with Cilium extended) via uint8/uint16 cell-ID encoding.
closure_criteria: Configure a partial-mesh topology over >3 cells and capture each cell connecting only to its k nearest neighbors with multi-hop routing reaching distant cells, plus a hub-and-spoke config validated; emit per-run UUID and attach the realized mesh adjacency.

title: Establish multi-cell integration testbed for CLAUDE-1 usability gate
